conclusions.AF2_multimer_ipTM_INVALID: AF2-multimer ipTM = 0.16 for a TRUE crystallographic nanobody binder (1MEL) — below the 0.7 gate and BELOW the non-cognate negative (0.23). AF2-multimer ipTM cannot recognize nanobody binders under this single-model/MSA protocol. Every prior NS1 ranking on AF2 ipTM is invalid as a binder/non-binder discriminator.
conclusions.Boltz2_ipTM_VALID: Boltz-2 ipTM = 0.957 for the true binder vs 0.422 non-cognate — clean discrimination (gap 0.53). Boltz-2 is the valid metric for this design campaign.
conclusions.truncation_confound_RESOLVED: nb3 vs full-length NS1 gives Boltz ipTM 0.591 — well below the true-binder 0.957 and only modestly above the non-cognate 0.422. Truncation was NOT masking a real nb3 interface; nb3 is a weak/non-binder against NS1 on Boltz too. The historical 0.553 'baseline' is in the non-binder regime, not a bar to beat.
conclusions.net: Harness IS valid (via Boltz-2). The NS1-directionB negative result stands for the FAILED designs. AF2-multimer ipTM must be dropped as a selection metric; re-rank all campaigns on Boltz-2 ipTM + structural epitope-contact filter.
